title: Peekaword
subtitle: A new word on your Lock Screen
description:
Learn a language in between everything else. Peekaword puts a new word on your Lock Screen and Home Screen, where you already look dozens of times a day.

No ads. None at all. All the learning is free.
privacy:
## In short

Peekaword collects no personal data. No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.

## Your data

Settings, learning progress, daily goal and streak are stored on your iPhone and shared between the app and its widgets. Progress (words, stats, streak and your own words) is also saved in your iCloud, so a new phone doesn't lose it. It stays in your iCloud; we have no access to it. You can turn this off in the app: Settings → Keep progress in iCloud. The app then offers to delete the copy in iCloud; other devices of yours that still save to iCloud will save their progress there again. Deleting the app deletes the data from the device.

## Pronunciation

Words are spoken by the voices built into iOS, on your device.

## Reminders

Reminders are local notifications created on your iPhone. They are optional and can be turned off in the app's Settings or in iOS Settings.

## Purchases

Optional subscriptions (monthly or yearly) are processed by Apple through the App Store. We never receive your name, email or payment details: the app only checks on your device what you have bought. Manage or cancel a subscription in iOS Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

## Crash reports

If you have chosen in iOS Settings to share analytics with app developers, Apple may send us anonymous crash and performance reports. They contain no personal information.

## Children

The app is suitable for all ages and collects no data from anyone, including children.

## Changes

If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date above.

## Contact

Questions? Write to [vkulikov.app@gmail.com](mailto:vkulikov.app@gmail.com).
